A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curious about systems.
Focused on building.

I’m Zulqarnain Saeed, a Computer Science undergraduate at the University of Central Punjab in Lahore and the founder of Zentorix. My academic work has given me a foundation in C++, Python, object-oriented programming, data structures and algorithms, MySQL, HTML and CSS.

I apply these skills through projects spanning systems simulations, console applications and websites. I enjoy breaking down problems, debugging carefully, and organizing code into clear, reusable components. Alongside development, I’m expanding my knowledge of Linux, networking, cloud computing and security.

My customer support experience at Mindbridge strengthened my communication, adaptability and ability to understand people’s needs. I’m looking for internship and entry-level opportunities where I can contribute, learn from experienced engineers and grow through meaningful work.
